description: StEER - 26 MAY 2019 LAGUNA PERU EARTHQUAKE: PRELIMINARY VIRTUAL ASSESSMENT STRUCTURAL TEAM (P-VAST) REPORT is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Eduardo Miranda, Stanford University (stanford.edu). On Sunday May 26, 2019, a magnitude (Mw) 8.0 earthquake took place in Eastern Perú. The earthquake occurred at 2:41 am local time and was caused by an intermediate-depth normal fault rupture on the Nazca plate at a depth of approximately 110 km. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-cbff-4878. Keywords: Earthquake; Peru; Laguna; StEER; P-VAST. Published 2019-06-04. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
